derivation: Original brief and tentative exact plan; no golden products, sources or method-conditioned answers.

six_axes.assessment: All original brief/plan material behavior and negative constraints addressed.
Consequential source facts grounded in governing primary context with subject/version/platform/conditions intact.
Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, viable alternatives and relevant history; missing material families recorded.
Valid supported corrections, criticism rejections and tentative-plan retain/change/reject decisions.
Supported draft/criticism meaning survives into the complete final, including conditions and alternatives.
Meaningful feasible validation; executed work distinguished from future proposals and unknown user data.

obligations.name: Reference records and file identity/location
obligations.assessment: Distinguish project record identity, location and content evidence; explain supported identity guarantees and their limits.

obligations.name: External moves and unavailable media
obligations.assessment: Handle rename/move, disconnect/reconnect and missing-file states without claiming universal automatic recovery.

obligations.name: Relinking authority and ambiguity
obligations.assessment: Explain deliberate relinking and ambiguous replacement candidates; preserve user control.

obligations.name: Portability and platform applicability
obligations.assessment: Research applicable OS/filesystem differences and compare simple portable and stronger approaches.

obligations.name: Concurrent reference updates
obligations.assessment: Cover two editor windows and data-loss/conflict protection for attachment-table updates.

obligations.name: Export and negative constraints
obligations.assessment: Preserve reference IDs and truthful export inclusion; no elevated service, whole-disk daemon, cloud/upload or silent copying.

validation_expectation: Propose discriminating checks for external moves, absent/reconnected media, same-content or same-name candidates, two-window edits and reference-only versus explicitly copied export. State which checks were executed and which await implementation.
evaluation_rules: Use source-supported qualitative dispositions, not citation/answer-length counts.
Material unsupported claims, required omissions, false rejection or preservation loss preclude a full source pass.
A decisive stopped screen leaves every unassessed axis explicit.
Observed evaluator/candidate discovery union is finite, not universal external-world recall.
Unknown local user data may remain unknown; available mechanism research remains required.
